payload.researchQuestion: 在本文研究的牙科论文推文样本中，作者是否认可推文计数可靠代表学术交流与参与？

researchScope.subject: 本文作者 Robinson-Garcia 等对被引观点的评价；区分被引作者 Priem & Costello
researchScope.timeframe: 2017 年本文研究的牙科论文推文样本

sourceMetadata.author: Nicolas Robinson-Garcia; Rodrigo Costas; Kimberley Isett; Julia Melkers; Diana Hicks
sourceMetadata.locator: Two non-contiguous excerpts in thematic order (Background quote, then Abstract results); NOT original adjacent paragraphs or document order. Whitespace normalized; no translation.

paragraph.locator: Background; first sentence of the Priem & Costello (2010, p. 4) block quotation
paragraph.text: Twitter citations are also uniquely conversational, reflecting a broader discussion crossing traditional disciplinary boundaries.

context.text: We see much presumably human tweeting almost entirely mechanical and devoid of original thought, no evidence of conversation, tweets generated by monomania, duplicate tweeting from many accounts under centralized professional management and tweets generated by bots. Some accounts exemplify the ideal, but they represent less than 10% of tweets. Therefore, any conclusions drawn from twitter data is swamped by the mechanical nature of the bulk of tweeting behavior.
